Reject any point whose cited evidence does not say what the advocate claims, and list it in rejected_points. Then decide BUY, SELL or HOLD as ONE decision with entry, size and exit: conviction 0-100, size_pct_of_max 0-100, stop_loss_bps and take_profit_bps (positive integers), horizon_minutes.
